stepNotes.1: Single-file unit at packages/ax-code/src/cli/cmd/init.ts exporting one yargs CommandModule (InitCommand:8) registered at boot.ts:96. Six options (--depth,--force,--dry-run,--directory,--wiki,--wiki-only-agents); handler at init.ts:53-131 delegates to Context.init (context/index.ts:36), the wiki façade (wiki/index.ts:1-3), and bootstrap (bootstrap.ts:4).
stepNotes.2: Only process side effect is process.exitCode=1 at init.ts:128 (wiki gen failure). AGENTS.md write happens inside Context.init (context/index.ts:73), not in this adapter. --directory flows through path.resolve+Filesystem.resolve (util/filesystem.ts:167) which canonicalizes via realpathSync and normalizes Win/MSYS/Cygwin/WSL paths; targeting an arbitrary dir is the command's intent, not a traversal bug. gitHeadCommit (wiki/native.ts:100) uses static literal argv. Empty catch at init.ts:91 is deliberate policy with a comment, not a silent swallow.
stepNotes.3: callerCwd (util/filesystem.ts:182) honors AX_CODE_ORIGINAL_CWD->$PWD->cwd so global --cwd launches resolve the user's real project. depth cast as DepthLevel at init.ts:56 is safe because yargs choices at :27 enumerates the four legal literals. dry-run returns at :61 before bootstrap at :79, skipping both AGENTS.md writes and wiki side effects — consistent with Context.init's dry-run contract. Loose spot: getWikiStatus at init.ts:83 omits repositoryHead that wiki.ts:74 supplies.
stepNotes.4: Nothing CPU-hot here; analyze(root) cost is fixed by the analyzer. bootstrap (bootstrap.ts:4) disposes Instance in a finally so no leak even when wiki gen throws. Dry-run returns before bootstrap so preview pays no bootstrap cost. bootstrap IS entered even when created=false so a no-op init still spins up Instance for the soft pointer refresh at :83-89 — acceptable for --wiki=false since getWikiStatus+ensureAgentsWikiPointers are cheap. runNativeWiki streams progress via onProgress (:119) and reports elapsed seconds.
stepNotes.5: Clean adapter boundary: CLI-only concerns (yargs, console.log, exitCode) here; domain logic imported from ../../context, ../../wiki, ../bootstrap. Does not reach into provider/graph/storage internals; wiki config read through resolveWikiRuntimeConfig (wiki/config.ts:35)->Config.get. ensureAgentsWikiPointers appears at :85 and :98 with slightly different option objects but not worth extracting for two sites. Handler is ~80 lines mixing four phases — borderline but readable.
stepNotes.6: No TODOs and no unintended dead code. Empty catch at init.ts:91 is deliberate policy with a comment, matching the audit's empty-catches=0 count. Nit: depth:string declared at :11 then cast as DepthLevel at :56; yargs choices already constrains runtime value so the cast is correct but the type could be tightened. Kebab options read with bracket access (args["dry-run"]:61, args["wiki-only-agents"]:106) vs camel with dot — forced by yargs convention, not a real inconsistency.
